youtube.title: Which country has the most doctors per person? Not the USA 🩺
youtube.description:
Germany, the United States or the third one? The richest health systems on Earth are beaten, per head, by a country most people would never guess, and its doctors are now leaving by the tens of thousands.
Guess before the map fills, then see the three nations as bars, watch one number fall, and learn where its doctors go.
Which flag did you pick?

facebook.text:
Which nation has the most doctors per person — Germany, the United States or Cuba?
The answer trains far more physicians than it keeps, and the number at home is dropping fast. How long did you wait for your last appointment?

twitter.text:
Which nation has the MOST doctors per person?
Not the one with the most hospitals, and not the one with the most money. Its doctors are now leaving by the tens of thousands.

threads.text: Which nation has the most doctors per person — Germany, the United States or Cuba? One of them trains physicians faster than it can keep them, posts them to dozens of other countries, and has watched the number at home shrink every year since the pandemic.
